fusions.name: Noose Across the Run
fusions.desc: Kicks a noose shut on the target that deals 11 damage and stuns it for 1 second. It has 30% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Led Across the Stakes
fusions.desc: Stakes spring up where you have run: the burst deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Break Cover
fusions.desc: Sets a snare at the nearest enemy that arms after 0.5 seconds and waits up to 20 seconds. It deals 16 damage to the first enemy to come within 2 tiles and leaves it [Slowed] for 5 seconds. You move 25% faster for 3 seconds after setting it.

fusions.name: Twitch of the Wire
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (18% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
